cards.explanation: The answer is that he gives it to some of the tribes as an inheritance. The text says Moses, the servant of the LORD, and the Israelites struck the kings down and "…given their land as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh." Three groups, and all three got a share, friends. I'd love to say I handed out cookies that fairly, but I always ate the broken ones first (Joshua 12:6).

The answer is Joshua, friends! Verse 7 says, "…these are the kings of the land that Joshua and the Israelites conquered beyond the Jordan to the west…" Moses handled the east, and Joshua took the west. Two leaders, two sides of the river, and one very long list.

The answer is False! The text says Joshua gave the land to the tribes as an inheritance, "according to the allotments to the tribes of Israel…" (Joshua 12:7). He won it, then handed it out. That's a leader who finishes a batch and shares the whole box, friends.
